name: Tomb Weed
summary: At Balnir Farmstead, Holland's altered doom weed now draws the Scourge. The crop has become a new specimen called tomb weed, and Holland wants it for his experiments.

sections.title: Holland's Cultivation
sections.body: Junior Apothecary Holland wants more than a place among the Royal Apothecary Society. He gathers doom weed, makes small alchemical changes, and replants it in the soil of Balnir Farmstead. There, he has cultivated a new strain he calls tomb weed. Holland sees the hybrid as the heart of his work and a sign of the future he seeks for himself.

sections.title: Unintended Attraction
sections.body: Holland expected his altered plants to gain alchemical potency, but the Scourge wandering Balnir Farmstead have taken an unexpected interest in them. He now depends on travelers to push past the undead and gather the mature crop, so his experiments can continue.

faq.answer: Tomb weed is a strain of doom weed that Junior Apothecary Holland has altered through alchemy. He plants the treated herb in the blighted soil of Balnir Farmstead.

Junior Apothecary Holland belongs to the Royal Apothecary Society and works in Tirisfal Glades. Ambitious and often frustrated by assistants such as the abomination Gordo, he pursues private plant and alchemical experiments to advance his standing.
Holland grows his altered crops at Balnir Farmstead, an abandoned estate in eastern Tirisfal Glades that has fallen into blight and ruin.

faq.q: Why are the Scourge attracted to tomb weed?
faq.answer: Holland has seen the mindless Scourge at Balnir Farmstead drawn to the altered plant, but he does not know why and finds it curious.

faq.q: How does tomb weed differ from normal doom weed?
faq.answer: Doom weed grows naturally near the mass gravesite north of the Brill graveyard. Holland creates tomb weed by altering doom weed through alchemy and replanting it in farmstead soil.

faq.q: Who is Gordo mentioned by Holland?
faq.answer: Gordo is a wandering abomination created by the Forsaken who roams Tirisfal Glades' roads. Holland often gives him simple tasks that prove difficult for his sluggish mind.

angles.text: As an Undead, you can see Holland's work in the Forsaken apothecaries' drive to reshape Tirisfal's blighted plants for alchemy.
As a herbalist, you know alchemical treatment can change a blighted herb such as doom weed and its behavior.
